macros.name: FlowframTkEndScopeIfGroup
macros.doc: Designed for use in the definition of \flowframtkendobject, this command will insert \end{pgfscope} if ⟨class name⟩ is JDRGroup, otherwise it will do nothing.

macros.name: flowframtkimgtitlechar
macros.doc: This normally just expands to ⟨char⟩ but if \pdfinfo is required, then this will expand to the detokenized ⟨PDF replacement⟩.

macros.name: flowframtkNoRagged
macros.doc: This command is defined to restore the paragraph justification back to the way it was when flowframtkutils was loaded, which should typically be full justification.

macros.name: FlowframTkScopeIfGroup
macros.doc: Designed for use in the definition of \flowframtkencapobject, this command will encapsulate ⟨object⟩ within the pgfscope environment if ⟨class name⟩ is JDRGroup, otherwise it will just do ⟨object⟩.

macros.name: flowframtkSetCreationDate
macros.doc: If hyperref has been loaded, this will use \hypersetup to set the PDF creation date, otherwise if \pdfinfo has been defined that will be used instead.

macros.name: flowframtkSetTitle
macros.doc: If hyperref has been loaded, this will use \hypersetup to set the document title meta data, otherwise if \pdfinfo has been defined that will be used instead.

macros.name: includeteximage
macros.doc: This command isn’t written to any exported file by FlowframTk but is provided by flowframtkutils to include an exported image (tex) file in a document.

macros.name: jdrimagebox
macros.doc: Used for encapsulated images, \jdrimagebox is designed to prevent problems if numerical rounding errors cause the image to be larger than the available area.

macros.name: jdroutline
macros.doc: If enabled by the outline option, \jdroutline will attempt to render ⟨text⟩ as an outline using ⟨pdf-trans code⟩ (if pdf-trans.tex was loaded) or ⟨pst-char code⟩ (if pst-char was loaded).
